summary: Replaced the recursive per-directory sorted traversal with a lazy explicit directory frontier. The Search source now consumes one filesystem entry at a time, keeps open enumerators bounded by traversal depth, checks cancellation around advancement, and retains typed failure when a discovered file vanishes before opening.

review.reviewer: separate grill-code review pass (no independent subagent was available)

startingState.head: 2e27bcb558909709829881716bce3842ddfcd7e5
startingState.worktree: Tracked files were clean at scope start; W04-S01 traversal implementation, tests and evidence were added afterward.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search traversal path and its tests were changed, together with W04-S01 evidence. No public API, sibling repository, query-engine adapter, release or publish surface was modified.

traversal.frontier: Stack of one live directory enumerator per open depth level.
traversal.entryConsumption: Filesystem entries are advanced and classified one at a time; the previous per-directory OrderBy materialization was removed.
traversal.entryRecord: SearchTraversalEntry stores path, directory classification and file classification as a readonly record struct.
traversal.cancellation: Cancellation is checked before root access, before and after directory enumerator advancement, before descending and at the existing file-scan boundaries.
traversal.failure: Directory enumeration access failures retain the existing SEARCH-SOURCE-002 typed diagnostic with the affected directory path; a candidate deleted before reader open remains a typed source-open failure.

requiredCoverage: candidate identities against the generated oracle

commands.executionWrapper: Direct PowerShell invocation with separate stdout/stderr capture; product argv is recorded above.

commands.argv: git diff --check; focused Search tests; exact full suite; campaign validator

gateResults.evidence: The exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 with 1,341 discovered, 1,310 passed, 0 failed and 31 existing expected skips; the focused Search suite exited 0 with 57 passed.
The approved separate review, exact source/artifact hashes and unique trailer-bearing completion commit are retained.
Real deep/wide/empty traversal identities and the existing Search oracle/row tests pass; deletion remains a typed source-access failure rather than an invented complete result.
Synthetic frontier tests prove one-entry advancement and disposal on exhaustion/cancellation; existing reader cancellation/disposal tests remain green.

knownLimitations: Filesystem enumeration order is not a SQL ordering contract; callers requiring order must use ORDER BY. Deterministic candidate manifests and ignore/link policy remain later scope responsibilities.
A live filesystem is not an atomic snapshot. If a candidate disappears before open, the scan fails with a typed source diagnostic rather than claiming an exhaustive result.
This scope proves traversal frontier behavior and candidate enumeration, not whole-search memory or throughput targets.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing classified skips, existing provider warnings and package advisories; no package was published.
